nguon: 💬 Giao tiếp · Tình huống khẩn · bài tự soạn
title: Group chat · Hana's lost wallet
L: Hana: Help! I think I left my wallet in the taxi.
Ben: Oh no! Don't panic. Call your bank and block your cards first.
Hana: Already done. But my ID card was in there too.
Mia: You should report it to the police. Do you remember the taxi number?
Hana: Yes! I took a photo of the receipt.
Ben: Great. Send it to me, and I'll come with you to the police station.
Hana: Thank you, guys. I don't know what I'd do without you.
Mia: No worries. We've got your back!

exq.q: Chỗ trống 1: I think I ___ my wallet in the taxi.
exq.why: left = quá khứ của leave; “I think I left…” = hình như tớ để quên.

exq.q: Chỗ trống 2: Call your bank and ___ your cards first.
exq.why: Call … and + V nguyên mẫu (lời dặn): block your cards.

exq.q: Chỗ trống 3: You should ___ it to the police.
exq.why: report sth to the police = trình báo cảnh sát.
got your back = luôn sẵn sàng giúp, ủng hộ cậu.

exq.q: Who will go to the police station with Hana?
exq.why: Ben: “I'll come with you to the police station.”
